description: This file contains PHP code responsible for updating relations between entities in the vtiger CRM system, specifically handling invoice-related relationships and redirecting to the appropriate detail or related list view.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A class representing a CRM entity with methods like getInstance for retrieving entity instances.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues such as SQL injection.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab information for the current context.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of the CRMEntity class for a specified module.

methods.name: relateEntities
methods.description: Establishes relationships between different CRM entities based on provided identifiers and modules.
